CustomField.label: Child Table
CustomField.description: Makes this a child total column: the API name of one of this grid's Grid Child Table records. The column shows, on each row, a total of that child table's records for the row, worked out with the child grid's own filters. Leave blank for a column on a field. With it, Field API Name is left blank and Child Total says what to work out.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For a child total column: the Grid Child Table (API name) whose records it totals for each row. Leave blank for a column on a field.
